name: Collage Art
description: Cut paper, a dashed edge, and pieces that look pasted down.
bestFor: Stories and portfolios that should feel assembled by hand.
promptFragment: Visual style: Collage Art. Layer paper-colored panels over split fields of color. Use a dashed cut-paper edge, a serif for body, and a hard offset shadow so each piece looks pasted on. Mix two or three unrelated hues. Avoid one neat corporate grid, glass blur, and polished gradients. Keep text readable: meet WCAG 2.2 AA contrast (4.5:1) against the surface the text actually sits on. https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/contrast-minimum.html
